label: Shielded — frame across the forge mouth
location: The Molten Forge, the forge mouth
injuries: Frame running over temperature; the presses behind it are cooling untended

recentEvents.value: The crucible-lines pour lava boundaries where heating stones should be cooling; the furnaces are losing their temper while it holds the door.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Somewhere a field will lie untilled because the forge was busy being a fortress.

temporaryObjective.value: Hold the forge mouth until the workers and the order book are out the cooling galleries.
